run_calculate_primes: run a multiprocessing pool to check primality of integers via gRPC
run_worker_query: run a worker query to check if a number is prime via gRPC stub
initialize_worker: initialize a worker process with a gRPC insecure channel and PrimeCheckerStub
shutdown_worker: shutdown a worker process by stopping the gRPC channel singleton
run_main: run the client to determine primality of the first 10000 integers via gRPC
